verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS operations-automation product like AFK, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or any opt-out control. The security features cited (scoped OAuth, encrypted secrets, audit logs) are adjacent controls, not an opt-out from tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
